title: Quantification of circulating microRNA using droplet digital PCR
author: Helle Glud Binderup
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q8edzte
materials: use 5 ml of EDTA anticoagulated whole blood
TaqMan®MicroRNA Reverse Transcription Kit Applied Biosystems (ThermoFisher Scientific) Catalog #4366597 20X TaqMan MicroRNA Assay Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #4440887
20X TaqMan MicroRNA Assay Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #4440887 ddPCR Supermix for probes (no dUTP) Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1863024

DG32™ Automated Droplet Generator Cartridges Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1864108 Automated Droplet Generation Oil for Probes Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1864110 (AutoDG, 1864101, Automated Droplet Generator from BioRad)

steps.title: Isolate Plasma from Whole Blood
steps.instruction: Isolate plasma using either a dual centrifugation method or a prolonged single centrifugation method.

substeps.instruction: Dual Centrifugation: Centrifuge 10 ml of EDTA anticoagulated whole blood at 3000 g for 15 minutes (acceleration 5, brake 6, temperature 18 °C).
Transfer plasma phase to a new tube, leaving approximately 1 mL of plasma on top of the buffy coat.
Centrifuge again at 3000 g for 15 minutes (acceleration 5, brake 6, temperature 18 °C).
Transfer plasma phase to cryo tubes, leaving approximately 1 ml of plasma in the bottom of the tube; store at -80 °C (Hettich centrifuge, 4706-01, Rotina 420R).
Alternative Single Centrifugation: Centrifuge 5 ml of EDTA anticoagulated whole blood at 3000 g for 30 minutes (acceleration 5, brake 6, temperature 18 °C).
Transfer plasma phase to cryo-tubes, leaving approximately 0.5 ml of plasma on top of the buffy coat.

steps.title: Prepare RT Primer Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the RT primer mix for each reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.75 µL of 20x RT primer from each microRNA assay set per reaction (e.g., for two assays, total volume is 1.5 µL).
Add 10-20% excess volume.
Mix gently.

steps.title: Prepare RT Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the RT master mix, ensuring a total reaction volume of 15 µL (including microRNA and RT-primers).

substeps.instruction: Add water to reach the total volume (e.g., 8.66 µL water when using two microRNA assays).
Add 10-20% excess volume.
Mix gently and place on ice.
Include a RT-negative sample (no template) and a RT-positive sample (microRNA-sample included in all runs).

steps.title: Set Up RT Reactions
steps.instruction: Combine the master mix, purified microRNA, and primer mix in reaction tubes.

substeps.instruction: Combine RT master mix with 2 µL of purified microRNA in a 0.2 µL polypropylene reaction tube (volume of master mix depends on number of RT-primers; e.g., 11.5 µL for two assays). Keep on ice.
Add the appropriate volume of RT primer mix to the tubes.
Mix gently and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction tubes in a thermocycler using the specified temperature profile.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 16 °C for 30 min.
Incubate at 42 °C for 30 min.
Incubate at 85 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Store or Proceed with cDNA
steps.instruction: Either continue immediately to PCR amplification or store the RT-reaction at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare ddPCR Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the ddPCR reaction mix, adding 10-20% excess volume and mixing gently.

steps.title: Prepare and Plate ddPCR Reactions
steps.instruction: Dilute the cDNA and combine with the ddPCR reaction mix in a 96 well plate.

substeps.instruction: Dilute each RT-reaction (cDNA) 1:10 with nuclease-free water (e.g., 2 µL cDNA + 18 µL water).
Combine 45.4 µL of ddPCR reaction mix with 2.6 µL of diluted RT-reaction (cDNA) in a 96 well plate.

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Run the PCR amplification in a thermocycler.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 95 °C for 5 minutes.
Perform 44 cycles of 95 °C for 15 sec and 60 °C for 60 sec.
Final incubation at 98 ºC for 10 min.
Cool to 4 °C.

steps.title: Generate Droplets
steps.instruction: Generate droplets using the AutoDG system.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 22 µL of the reaction mixture into each of two wells on an empty 96 well plate.
Heat seal the plate.
Transfer plate to the AutoDG to transfer 20 µL from each well to a GD32 cartridge for droplet generation.
Heat seal the output plate.

steps.title: Analyze and Normalize Data
steps.instruction: Perform ddPCR analysis and normalize the results.

substeps.instruction: Analyze samples using QX100 Droplet Reader and QuantaSoft Software.
Normalize by calculating the relative concentration of target miRNA and cel-miR-39.
